_readme: Fridge calendar (scripts/daily.gd + scripts/fridge_calendar.gd). One entry per day of the month; day 1 is a Friday. 'card' = Duff's line on the wake splash (bar voice, present tense). 'tag' = scribble in the grid square. 'notes' = sticky notes on the fridge: from hero | partner | baby | cat1 | cat2 | cat3. 'headline': true blocks the random daily event and the bill roll that morning. 'event' = special handler in main (falcor, gala, thanksgiving). 'tag_from' = the tag only shows from that day on (the gala tag appears once the invite lands). Tokens like {partner} come from data/cast.json. Days past the end of the month have no entry: the daily event pool carries them.

1.card: Friday. Payday is a rumor I heard once.

notes.text: Milk. Wipes. You. In that order. <3
the bowl is half empty. fix it.

2.card: Saturday. No shift. Just me and my unfinished business.

notes.text: Why is someone called 'The Ghoster' at the Seen Cafe asking for you. Handle it. Home for dinner.
Handling it. I'm the dinner.

3.card: Sunday. {partner} sets a bowl on the porch for the orange stray. She names him {stray}.

notes.text: Do NOT tell me he's 'not our cat.' He's {stray}. He has a bowl now.
who is the porch cat. explain yourselves.

4.card: Rent day. The landlord's love language is Venmo.

notes.text: Rent's paid. Don't look at the account. Just trust me.
I looked.

5.card: {baby} discovers her own feet. All production halts.

notes.text: SHE FOUND HER FEET. Ask her about them. She'll show you.
(a purple scribble that might be a foot)

6.card: Hump day. I am the camel.

notes.text: Why does the mail say 'VIP list, Club Cloud 9.' We're talking later.
It's a boss fight. I swear on the cats.

7.card: {stray} leaves a dead moth on the welcome mat. {partner} calls it a love letter.

notes.text: {stray} brought us a GIFT. Don't throw it out until I see it.
the porch cat is showing off. noted.

8.card: Payday. Rush night. The Fork smells like money and pickle brine.

notes.text: Late one tonight. Save me the end of the mac.
Saving it. Not promising.

9.card: {stray}'s bowl is still full this morning. {partner} checks it twice.

notes.text: {stray} didn't eat. Keep an eye out on your walk?
Looked twice. Left a can by the steps.

11.card: Rent day. {partner} does the budget app without The Face. That's worse.

notes.text: Made you coffee. The good beans. I love you.
bowl's still on the porch. not ready to move it.

12.card: The tower's lit up downtown. Somebody's waiting on the top floor.

notes.text: Come home in one piece. I mean it.
left you something under the couch. you're welcome.

13.card: {partner} moves the porch bowl inside. Doesn't throw it out.

notes.text: Moved {stray}'s bowl in. Don't move it.
sat by the new bowl all day. guarding it.

14.card: Thanksgiving's coming. Earl wants to know if I'm 'doing a bird.'

notes.text: Earl invited us to Waffle Haus for Thanksgiving. That's a no, right?
It's a yes. Dolores makes pie.

15.card: Payday. Half of it already belongs to somebody else.

notes.text: Baby pics tomorrow. Wear the shirt without the stain.
Which one is that

16.card: Picture day. {baby} cries in all of them. They're perfect.

notes.text: the flash was rude.
Leftovers are SPOKEN FOR. (by me)
Respect.

18.card: Rent day. The landlord texts 'thx :)'. The smiley costs extra.

notes.text: Rent paid. We have $11 and each other.
and the cats

19.card: First real cold. {city} clears its throat.

notes.text: Gloves are in the drawer. TAKE THEM.
close the door. the outside keeps getting in.

20.card: Wednesday. The coffee is doing the heavy lifting.

notes.text: Fixed the cabinet. Don't open it.
i opened it

21.card: The fryer at work is making a new noise. So am I.

notes.text: Date night Sat?? Sitter's booked. Don't make me wear the outfit alone.

22.card: Payday. Date night's tomorrow. I iron a shirt like it owes me money.

notes.text: Reservation at 7. Wearing the good shirt.
The GOOD good shirt?

23.card: Date night. {partner} gets her eyeliner in one try. A miracle on a Saturday.

notes.text: you were gone three hours. we have filed a complaint.

24.card: Sunday. Gold envelope under the door: THE ELITE GALA. We sleep till nine anyway.

notes.text: Day 24: The Gala. Wear the shirt. The GOOD good shirt.
It says black tie. I own one tie. It's brown.
(one purple line, very confident)

25.card: Rent day. Thanksgiving week. The landlord is thankful for me, specifically.

notes.text: Thurs list: stuffing, cranberry, the GOOD butter. Do not forget the good butter.
What's the bad butter
you'll know

26.card: A turkey costs what my first car cost. My first car was also a turkey.

notes.text: Got the good butter.
MY HERO

27.card: Night before Thanksgiving. The Fork is a war zone of pie orders.

notes.text: the box on the counter smells like bird. investigating.
i am not involved.

28.card: Thanksgiving. Waffle Haus. Earl says grace. It's mostly about the Huskers.

notes.text: Thankful for you. Even the cabinet. <3

29.card: Black Friday. I work. The mall can fight itself.

notes.text: Leftover pie's in the oven so the cats can't get it.
the cats can

30.card: Last day of the month. The calendar's covered in us. I don't throw it out.

notes.text: New calendar goes up tomorrow. Same us.
Same us.
